review.title: Unexpected Results when Using Math Function SIN

oracle.normal_result_sets: Exactly one of P and NOT P selects the unique row (1,0), with non-NULL measured SIN result. No platform-specific fixed SIN decimal assumed.

oracle.on_sql_error: These selected reports target wrong results, not SQL errors; unexpected SQL errors mean execution_failed, never automatically reproduced.
oracle.on_other_pattern: other_anomaly; do not attribute an unexpected pattern to the report
oracle.boundary_review_note: P and NOT P cannot both select unchanged (1,0) when measured SIN is finite/non-NULL. Use complementarity, not a prescribed libm decimal; target selects row twice.
